lines.1: 「Um, Tsushima? A third-year is asking for you. She's gorgeous, but she looks kind of scary. My calculations give you a seventy-percent chance of getting yelled at.」
lines.2: W-why was she so fixated on me?
lines.3: 「This daily game of telephone can't go on forever, buddy. How about you finally face the music?」
lines.4: The long weekend was almost here, too.
lines.6: 「At last, we have an opportunity to speak.」
lines.7: 「Still, this is the first I have heard of your taking lessons. I was told nothing about that.」
lines.9: 「You attend an abacus school, do you not?」
lines.13: 「Not exactly a lie. More like sarcasm.」
lines.14: 「I have taught you since long ago not to lie so casually.」
lines.15: 「Why did you lie? Look me in the eyes and answer.」
lines.16: 「Well... Miss Kurogane, someone I'd never met, kept bothering me, and it was getting annoying.」
lines.17: 「This is not our first meeting! How rude!」
